name: Lebanon

flag.description: Three horizontal bands of red, white and red, with the white band twice as tall as each red one, and a green cedar tree in the center.
flag.symbolism: The cedar represents holiness, eternity and peace; red stands for the blood shed for liberation and white for peace and the snow of the mountains.

hook: Lebanon is Austria's red-white-red with a big green cedar tree planted in the middle.
trivia: The flag was adopted on 7 December 1943, shortly after independence from French rule.
The Cedars of God grove in northern Lebanon is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
